notes:
Fixes a bug that could make Corylus read a document as if it had no title, no synopsis and no identity at all — and then treat it as a different document. Whether it happened depended on something invisible: where the accented letters fell in the text. Three documents in one project were affected and two of them had to be rewritten by hand. Accented text is now read correctly wherever it falls, and affected documents recover their title and their place the next time the project opens.

- When a sync replaced your binder structure with the other computer's, the repairs made when the project opened were left behind until the next launch. They are now applied straight away.
- Documents can no longer disappear from the binder while their file sits safely on disk: a project's structure and its search index could disagree about which document was which, and once they did, moving that document stopped working. Affected projects repair themselves on open.
- A document moved into a folder could stop being found by search, because its entry still pointed at the folder it came from.
- Fixed a Windows bug that could lose an edit Corylus had just merged.
- Your backup folder is remembered per computer instead of travelling with the project.
